An '''echo golem''' is a {{MCD2|golem}} {{MCD2|mob}} found in {{MCD2|the Sift}}, and first encountered in the {{MCD2|Down into the Deep Dark}} {{MCD2|quest}}. They are powered by {{MCD2|soul block}}s and were created by the {{MCD2|Singer}}s with the purpose to "assist everyone".<ref name=rift>{{Cite Rift}}</ref> They also possess a red variant, which appears in {{MCD2|The Final Souldown}} quest. 
== Lore ==
The echo golems are {{MCD2|golem}}s created by {{MCD2|singer}}s as caretakers of the {{MCD2|the Sift}} and with the purpose to "assist everyone". They are made of a gray-green substance squishier than stone, and are powered up by a {{MCD2|soul block}}, which contains its memories and melodies within.

As any golem, echo golems do not need to eat, but still need to recharge their soul blocks with {{MCD2|soul}}s, which they do so by bathing in {{MCD2|ichor}}. They communicate through chirps and whirrs, however, the sounds are somehow translated into words directly into {{MCD2|hero}}es' minds. They can also understand the singer's notes, using that ability to translate it to heroes.

The Singer puts them in charge to be the guardians of The  Sift. The echo golems welcome  the {{MCD2|High Council}} when they open the portal to the Sift. The golems offer to share the souls' boundless power, but the Illagers do not want to share the power and kill the echo golems for the soul blocks on their heads.

== Trivia ==
* The face of an echo golem can be seen melded into the {{MCD2|Monstrous Opus}}' shoulder piece, revealing that at least one of them was used in the creation of the soul construct.
